name: Figure 03

source.quote: Figure 03 is an upgraded humanoid robot from Figure AI, announced for Spartanburg on June 25, 2026

timeline.detail: Figure 03 announced as successor to Figure 02, with soft safety components, wireless charging, tactile-sensor hands, and speech-to-speech communication.

source.quote: Figure 03 is an upgraded humanoid robot from Figure AI, announced for Spartanburg on June 25, 2026, with soft safety components, wireless charging, speech-to-speech communication, and improved tactile-sensor hands.

timeline.detail: Figure publishes its own account of Figure 03 arriving and working at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg, Hall 52, performing a parts-sequencing task under whole-body VLA control (Helix 02).

source.quote: Figure 03's hands, arms, torso, and feet ... fluidly switches between precise picking and placement of thin-walled, individual parts and forceful manipulation requiring whole-body coordination.

timeline.detail: Delivered to BMW Group Plant Spartanburg (Hall 52), following on from Figure 02's 30,000-vehicle run at the same plant.

source.quote: Humanoid robot Figure 03 at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg.

notes: No manufacturer-published height/weight/DoF spec sheet for Figure 03 was located on figure.ai during this build (figure.ai/product returned HTTP 404); specs are left empty rather than filled from secondary blogs. Follow-up: check Figure's press kit or a dated product page once published.

Shipped bar applied (2026-09-20): BMW's own press portal (press.bmwgroup.com) published a 7-photo compilation on 2026-06-25 captioned "Humanoid robot Figure 03 at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg" -- a named customer (BMW Group Plant Spartanburg) with photographic evidence of the physical unit, published via the customer's own channel. Per this site's shipped rule, a named customer plus image via the customer's or an independent channel is sufficient; invoice/serial/unboxing/customs are alternatives, not an added requirement. Upgraded to shipped. (An earlier note in this file required invoice/serial/unboxing/customs in addition to the photo; that conjunctive reading was too strict and is removed.)
